description: Origins, development, and evolution of the global internet

origins.arpanet: 1969; DARPA-funded network; first message sent October 29, 1969 between UCLA and Stanford
origins.packet_switching: Leonard Kleinrock and Paul Baran; data broken into packets routed independently
origins.ncp: Network Control Protocol; early ARPANET protocol (1970)
origins.tcp_ip: Vint Cerf and Bob Kahn (1974); Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol; became internet foundation
origins.dns: Paul Mockapetris (1983); Domain Name System; translated IPs to human-readable names

components.html: HyperText Markup Language; structures web pages
components.http: HyperText Transfer Protocol; transfers web data
components.url: Uniform Resource Locator; web address format

world_wide_web.first_browser: WorldWideWeb by Berners-Lee (1990); then Mosaic (1993) made web accessible to public

major_milestones.1991: WWW publicly available; Gopher protocol popular
major_milestones.1993: Mosaic browser; first graphical web browser
major_milestones.1998: Google founded by Brin and Page; PayPal founded
major_milestones.2004: Facebook founded; Gmail launched; Firefox browser
major_milestones.2007: iPhone and mobile internet era begins

web_generations.web_2_0: User-generated content, social media, interactive apps (2004–present)
web_generations.web_3_0: Decentralized web, blockchain, semantic web, AI integration (emerging)

internet_governance.icann: Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers; manages domain names and IPs
internet_governance.iana: Internet Assigned Numbers Authority; allocates IP addresses and protocols
internet_governance.ietf: Internet Engineering Task Force; develops internet standards
internet_governance.w3c: World Wide Web Consortium; web standards (Berners-Lee directs)

social_media_impact.arab_spring: Social media aided 2010–2012 protests across Arab world
social_media_impact.misinformation: Rapid spread of false information at scale
social_media_impact.business_models: Attention economy; advertising targeting; data monetization
